topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: Of course, you can have part of the yard for your garden! I mean, just imagine all those beautiful plants and veggies we could share. It’s going to be fantastic having you tend to something so lively and green right there. And hey, it’ll be fun to learn from you—I’ve always wanted to get better at gardening. We can spend afternoons out there, maybe even have a little tea party or something once everything starts blooming. I’m really looking forward to it, and thanks for asking, truly. Let’s do this!
